game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber, a booming echo chamber: the spelunker must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled pickaxes but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber: a booming echo chamber
core_gameplay_loop: In Echo Chamber, repeat each round: Use continue to skip spoiled pickaxes but keep the loop running. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the skipped_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the crystal door using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The crystal door reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the crystal door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Continue Gate
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Continue Gate' (Week 4 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Echo Chamber'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how skipped_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Echo Chamber.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The crystal door reached with actions_used <= 14.
